setwd("/Users/jb/Desktop")
library(car) 

data = read.csv("boston_cleaned.csv") 
set.seed(2641)
train_index <- sample(1:nrow(data), 0.8 * nrow(data))
train_data <- data[train_index, ]
test_data <- data[-train_index, ]
model <- lm(MEDV ~ ., data = train_data)
summary(model)
vif(model)

model2 <- lm(MEDV ~ CRIM + ZN + CHAS + NOX + RM + DIS + PTRATIO + LSTAT, data = train_data)
summary(model2)
vif(model2)

model3 <- lm(MEDV ~ ZN + CHAS + NOX + RM + DIS + PTRATIO + LSTAT, data = train_data)
summary(model3)
vif(model3)

test_pred <- predict(model3, newdata = test_data)
test_r2 <- 1 - (sum((test_data$MEDV - test_pred)^2) / sum((test_data$MEDV - mean(train_data$MEDV))^2))
test_mae <- mean(abs(test_data$MEDV - test_pred))
test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$MEDV - test_pred)^2))
cat("Test R-squared:", test_r2, "\n")
cat("Test MAE:", test_mae, "\n")
cat("Test RMSE:", test_rmse, "\n")
